meta.concept:
This project is a fully realized third-person open-world action game targeting PC, focusing on vehicular traversal and high-mobility parkour mechanics within a cyberpunk setting. The player navigates a rain-soaked megacity using a rideable hoverbike controller paired with an on-foot character capable of wall-running, vaulting, and sliding. Visual interaction is managed through a Cinemachine third-person camera system configured with lock-on targeting for combat and bounty tracking, while input handling manages vehicle steering, traversal actions, and weapon firing via standard PC keyboard and mouse configurations.

Core architecture requires a hybrid physics stack to manage rigid-body vehicles alongside humanoid ragdolls for combat interactions, supported by an Enemy AI framework utilizing NavMesh for patrol, chase, and alert states. Critical subsystems include a Bounty Manager to track live contracts simultaneously, a District Manager handling ambient audio transitions and sky color shifts per zone, and a Dialogue manager implementing in-world hologram events for the eight story acts. Additional infrastructure covers a Day-night cycle controller for dynamic lighting, a Vehicle Controller for hoverbike mechanics, a Weapon system for ranged and melee combos, an Inventory system, and a Save and checkpoint system between acts to preserve progress across distinct districts.

The render pipeline utilizes URP to support post-processing effects essential to the stylized neon aesthetic, including bloom and chromatic aberration. The project runs on Unity 6 LTS (version 6000.0), leveraging tools like Cinemachine, Input System, NavMesh components, ProBuilder for procedural geometry generation in tunnel and rooftop districts, and a Minimap radar component for spatial awareness. Asset management relies on resolution presets for terrain, road networks, water planes, and room layouts to ensure performance across six distinct zones while maintaining the defined color palette without external engine dependencies.
meta.user_prompt:
Neon Fugitive — a third-person open-world cyberpunk bounty-hunter game for PC.

The player is a rogue AI enforcement agent navigating six districts of a rain-soaked
megacity at night. Each district has its own visual identity: neon markets, industrial
docks, corporate towers, underground tunnels, a rooftop skyway, and the flooded
outer slums. All six districts plus a main menu, a boss arena, and a credits scene
must be separate Unity scenes.

NARRATIVE — eight acts of escalating story beats:
1. Activation: player boots up for the first time in an alley (on_start)
2. First Mark: player receives the first bounty contract (on_enter_zone)
3. Street Chase: player pursues mark through market crowds (on_enemy_death)
4. Betrayal: handler reveals the player is also a target (on_timer)
5. Underground: player escapes into the tunnel district (on_enter_zone)
6. Data Heist: player steals identity files from corporate tower (on_pickup)
7. Showdown: final confrontation with the original programmer (manual)
8. Escape: player reaches the sky-bridge extraction point (on_enter_zone)

AUDIO — rich layered soundscape across eight tracks:
- Pulsing synth main theme (looping music, plays on menu)
- District market ambient (looping ambient, tense urban crowd)
- Industrial dock drone (looping ambient, machinery hum and water)
- Chase adrenaline track (looping music, fast-paced synth percussion)
- Corporate tower tension (looping music, slow arpeggiated suspense)
- Rain and thunder environment (looping ambient, outdoor weather)
- Combat hit and gunshot SFX pack (non-looping sfx, action punctuation)
- Victory sting and credits outro (non-looping music, emotional resolution)

PROCEDURAL GEOMETRY — runtime-built world pieces:
- Procedural terrain for the outer slum district (terrain type, resolution 64)
- Procedural road network grid for market district (road type, resolution 48)
- Procedural water plane for the flooded outer zone (water type, resolution 32)
- Procedural room layout for the corporate tower interior (room type, resolution 24)

SYSTEMS — everything this game needs:
- Third-person player movement with parkour (wall-run, vault, slide)
- Cinemachine third-person camera with lock-on targeting mode
- Enemy AI with NavMesh patrol, chase, and alert states
- Bounty system tracking multiple live contracts simultaneously
- Health and damage system with shields and healing pickups
- Dialogue manager playing all eight story beats as in-world hologram events
- District manager switching ambient audio and sky color per zone transition
- Day-night cycle controller driving scene lighting and NPC schedules
- Vehicle controller for rideable hoverbikes in open sections
- Weapon system managing ranged and melee attack combos
- Inventory and equipment screen
- Minimap radar displaying bounty targets and district boundaries
- Save and checkpoint system between acts
- ProBuilder level generator producing the tunnel and rooftop districts at edit time

VISUAL STYLE: stylized — heavy neon on deep dark backgrounds.
COLOR PALETTE name "NeonFugitive":
  primary   #00F5FF  (player energy — cyan glow)
  secondary #1A0A2E  (environment base — near-black violet)
  accent    #FF2D78  (enemies and hazards — hot pink)
  background #0D0D1A (sky and voids — pitch dark blue)
  trim      #FFD600  (UI, collectibles, highlights — electric yellow)

RENDER PIPELINE: URP (post-processing bloom and chromatic aberration essential).
UNITY VERSION: 6000.0
PLATFORM: PC

audio_cues.gen_prompt: High-pitched electric hum vibrating through wet carbon fiber under heavy neon rain.
Sharp metallic screeching as wheels slide across slick, reflective rooftop surfaces.
Rhythmic thumping of synthetic soles striking damp concrete and glass panels.
Soft static hiss fading into crisp synthesized voice from floating blue light.
Subtle mechanical whirring as the circular minimap rotates to track distant targets.
Heavy metallic clatter of spent casings hitting wet pavement near feet.
Low frequency rumble shifting from industrial factory drone to quiet rainforest chirps.
Deep bass swell as artificial neon glow fades into natural moonlight reflection.
Short digital chime echoing slightly in the damp, resonant megacity air.
Aggressive mechanical growling mixed with distant sirens from patrol drones above.
